comment: One tool per catalog operation, listed to the ChatGPT client profile (tools/typed.py). Parameters come from the bundled catalog, less location parameters; an entry's omit_parameters leaves optional ones out, and its parameters narrows one that stays (required, a smaller enum, its own description or example); parameter_descriptions fills a parameter the catalog leaves undescribed.

parameter_descriptions.outputsize: Number of most recent values to return (1-5000, default 30).
parameter_descriptions.range: Lookback window: 1mo, 3mo, 6mo, 1y, 2y, 5y, 10y, ytd or max. Chosen from the interval when omitted.
parameter_descriptions.time_period: Look-back period in bars, for example 14.
